summary: Strategy Inc filed a routine 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing weekly capital-markets activity for September 14-20, 2026: no at-the-market share sales, 950 bitcoin purchased for $75.7 million at an average $79,670, lifting holdings to 846,000 BTC (aggregate cost $63.80 billion, average $75,416), and 1,771,238 STRC preferred shares repurchased for $174.0 million. Remaining capacity is $875.1 million under the digital credit securities repurchase program and $1.0 billion for MSTR. No deal, tender, or board recommendation is involved; watch bitcoin price sensitivity and preferred dividend coverage.
